inputs.text: President Luis Abinader continued his high-level agenda in France this week, focusing on the Dominican Republic’s integration into global standards for transparency. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris, formalizing a partnership to design the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy.
